Collaborating effectively with Commission staff, Division attorneys and accountants, both the Commission's and the Division of Enforcement's Offices of the Chief Accountant, and other regulatory bodies, as well as communicating with courts, opposing counsel, and private industry representatives.

s.t:
Wir fördern Chancengleichheit und schätzen Vielfalt. Wir verpflichten uns, ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeitende zu schaffen.
yfood wächst international: Obwohl Deutschland unsers „Home Base“ ist, haben wir mit unseren internationalen Märkten ein dynamisches und buntes Umfeld geschaffen, in dem viele spannende Themen auf Dich warten.
Agilität ist uns wichtig. Daher arbeiten wir in einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell und bieten dir die Möglichkeit mit Workation aus dem EU-Ausland zu arbeiten.
Urlaub ist wichtig. Daher erhältst du bei uns 30 Tage bezahlten Urlaub im Jahr.
yfood hält dich fit . Mit einer subventionierten Mitgliedschaft bei EGYM-Wellpass kannst du dir für nur 29€ im Monat Gutes tun. Dazu bieten wir im Rahmen unseres Gesundheitsmanagements & Healthy@yfood Workshops und Aktionen (z.B. Yoga, Breathwork, Soccer, Pickleball) an.
Gemeinsam Gutes tun. Mit unserem yforgood Day erhältst du einen bezahlten Tag pro Jahr, um gemeinsam mit deinem Team eine soziale, gemeinnützige oder ökologische Initiative zu unterstützen.
Weg vom Fleck . Wir steuern 30€ zu deinem ÖPNV-Ticket bei und bieten dir über JobRad die Möglichkeit, vergünstigt ein Fahrrad zu leasen.
Trainiere deine Geschmacksnerven . Bei uns ist jeder der Lust hat Teil unseres Sensory-Teams. Probiere also neue Produkte, Sorten oder Geschmäcker vor allen anderen. Ansonsten gibt es so viel yfood wie du tragen kannst, natürlich auch für dich gratis.
Als Start-Up hat man oft mit Klischees zu kämpfen . Manche sind aber auch wahr. Daher gibt es bei uns natürlich auch einen Obstkorb, deinen gratis Koffein-Kick oder das stille Wässerchen.
Come as you are. Ob im Anzug oder Einhorn-Onesie. Einen Dresscode kennen wir nicht.

### **Candidate Profile** ###
You hold a Master-s degree or equivalent qualification in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline and have at least 5 years of relevant professional experience.
Previous experience within energy, commodities or trading would be highly valued. Candidates from Big Four or similar audit/advisory environments with strong exposure to trading, financial instruments or complex transactional businesses are also encouraged to apply.
**You bring:**
* Strong accounting expertise and a good understanding of how transactions flow through a trading organisation.
* Previous exposure to commodity trading and/or derivatives accounting.
* Good knowledge of IFRS and/or relevant statutory accounting requirements.
* Strong analytical and reconciliation skills, with the ability to investigate complex issues and understand their root causes.
* A high level of autonomy and the ability to take ownership of topics from identification through to resolution.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to interact with Trading, Finance, control functions, IT and auditors.
* Experience working with ERP and/or ETRM systems.
* Advanced Excel skills and a strong interest in data, digitalisation and process automation.
* Experience with Power Query, Power BI, SQL and/or Python would be a strong asset.
* Strong numerical and quantitative skills.
* A continuous improvement and project management mindset.
* Self-motivated, with a focus on enhancing processes, controls and operational efficiency.
* Full professional proficiency in English.
You are rigorous and analytical while remaining pragmatic and solution-oriented. You are comfortable operating in a fast-moving trading environment, managing competing priorities and working to demanding reporting deadlines.
You are naturally curious about how trading activity flows through systems and financial statements and are motivated not only by identifying issues, but by understanding their root causes and improving the underlying processes.
We are committed to meet the energy needs of a growing population and we are committed to the energy transition. The volatility of the energy trading markets requires excellence in risk management and a culture of innovation. We are fully embracing the digital revolution.

### **Context & Environment** ###
**TotalEnergies Trading & Shipping operates at the heart of international energy markets, bringing together trading activities across a broad range of energy commodities and financial products.**
Based in Geneva, you will join the **Trading Accounting team supporting TotalEnergies Gas & Power activities**, covering natural gas, LNG, power, emissions and derivatives. You will support a large and complex trading activity involving physical and financial transactions across multiple markets, counterparties and systems.
Trading Accounting plays a key role in ensuring that trading activities are accurately reflected in the financial statements and supported by robust accounting processes and controls. The team works closely with Trading Control, Middle Office, Back Office, Treasury, Risk Control, Tax, IT and Financial Reporting.
As Senior Trading Accountant, you will take ownership of complex accounting and control topics and act as a senior point of reference within the team. Beyond producing accurate financial information, you will be expected to understand the underlying trading activity, investigate issues across systems and processes, challenge existing ways of working and drive topics through to resolution.
The position combines trading accounting, analysis, controls, stakeholder management and continuous improvement, with a high level of autonomy and exposure across the organisation.
